data.one_liner: Allow setting and listening to fullscreen state on all platforms in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows setting and exiting fullscreen mode across Web, Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS. It also lets developers listen to fullscreen status changes using a listener mixin.
use_when: You need to toggle fullscreen mode across multiple platforms including desktop, mobile, and web.
You need to listen to changes in fullscreen state in your UI widgets.
avoid_when: You only need basic mobile status bar hiding without cross-platform window management.
strengths: Supports all platforms including Web, Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
Includes built-in listener support to track fullscreen status changes.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic README and example.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` and `await FullScreen.ensureInitialized();` in main.
